title: The principal classes of relevant facts — Arts. 19 to 29

cards.title: Art. 19 — same transaction
cards.text: Res gestae: what was said or done at or about the time

cards.title: Art. 20 — cause and effect
cards.text: Occasion, cause, effect, state of things, opportunity

cards.title: Art. 21 — motive and conduct
cards.text: Motive, preparation, previous or subsequent conduct; prompt complaint

cards.title: Art. 22 — explanatory facts
cards.text: Introduce, explain, identity, time, place, relation of parties

cards.title: Art. 23 — conspiracy
cards.text: Acts and words of one conspirator relevant against all

cards.title: Art. 24 — alibi
cards.text: Facts inconsistent, or making a fact highly probable / improbable

cards.title: Arts. 25–26
cards.text: Damages; existence of a right or custom

cards.title: Arts. 27–28 — mind and design
cards.text: State of mind or body; series of similar acts

cards.title: Art. 29 — course of business
cards.text: The usual practice shows the act was done
